Jade_Fiora.name: Fiora
Jade_Fiora.lore:
- Lunge (Q) is a targeted dash with a recast
- Riposte (W) has passive Attack Damage, the stab has no Stun or Slow
- Burst of Speed (E) grants Movement Speed on attacks and refreshes on kill
- Passive and R are completely different. Read the ability descriptions

spells.name: Lunge
spells.description: Fiora dashes forward to strike her target, dealing physical damage. Fiora can perform the dash a second time within a couple of seconds at no mana cost
spells.tooltip:
Fiora dashes forward to strike her target, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage.

Fiora can Recast this Ability to dash a second time within 4 seconds at no Mana cost.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Riposte
spells.description: Fiora's Attack Damage is increased. When activated, Fiora parries the next basic attack and reflects magic damage back to the attacker. Works against champions, monsters, and large minions.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Fiora's Attack Damage is increased by {{ bonusad }}.

Active: Fiora parries the next Attack within 1.5 seconds and reflects {{ reflectiondamage }} magic damage back to the attacker. Works against champions, monsters, and large minions.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Burst of Speed
spells.description: Fiora temporarily gains additional Attack Speed. Each attack or Lunge she lands during this time increases her Move Speed. Killing a champion refreshes the Cooldown on this Ability.
spells.tooltip:
Fiora gains {{ asbonus*100 }}% Attack Speed for 3 seconds. Each Attack or Lunge she lands during this time grants Fiora {{ msbonus*100 }}% Move Speed for 3 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

Killing a champion refreshes this Ability's Cooldown. (Assists reduce the Cooldown by {{ halfcooldown }} seconds){{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Blade Waltz
spells.description: Fiora dashes around the battlefield to deal physical damage to enemy champions. Successive strikes against the same target deal less damage.
spells.tooltip:
Fiora dashes around the battlefield striking random champions 5 times for {{ totaldamage }} physical damage. Successive Attacks against the same target deal {{ totaldamagereduced }} physical damage instead.

The first and last Attack will be against the same target. Each Attack applies On-Hit effects.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Duelist
passive.description: Fiora regenerates health over time when she deals damage. Striking champions will cause this effect to stack multiple times.
